server_description: Query ScenarioOntology in Fabric IQ, the live map of customers, orders and shipments, as the signed-in user: Customer (CustomerId, CustomerName, ServiceTier), SalesOrder (OrderId, OrderDate, PromisedDate, OrderStatus, DelayBusinessDays, OrderSummary), Shipment (ShipmentId, Carrier, ShipmentStatus, StatusDetail, CurrentLocation, LastUpdate, CarrierEta, EtaFreshness), PlacedBy, linking each sales order to its customer, and Delivers, linking each shipment to its sales order. Ask exactly one question about the rows of one entity, with each value in quotes, naming the properties you need, including its customer's through PlacedBy and its shipment's through Delivers; never ask for everything related. Use this form: Which SalesOrder rows have the OrderId value "SO-12345"? Return each order's status, promised date, DelayBusinessDays and summary, its customer's name and service tier, and its shipment's ID, status, detail, location, last update, CarrierEta and EtaFreshness. Cite rows by entity and key. Read-only.
